## About
Welcome to Sipe Bros-Marathon on 3rd Street SE in Osseo. We provide expert auto and light truck repair and maintenance for folks in Osseo, Maple Grove, Brooklyn Park, Champlin, Dayton and Crystal. We're your local Napa AutoCare Center, and our certified technicians handle everything from batteries to tune-ups.
We take the time to explain every job and give you an estimate before any repairs. One reviewer put it simply: "They only fix what needs to be fixed and thoroughly explains what they find."
While your car is in the shop, grab a snack in the convenience store. Fill up at the Marathon pumps, refill a propane tank, or run your car through the new Washworld wash. Neighbors rate us 4.5 on Google from 94 reviews.

## Services
- Auto Repair: Regular maintenance and diagnostic trouble shooting for cars and light trucks, from brake repair on up. Request an appointment and we'll take a look.
- Maintenance Special: Lube, oil and filter change with a tire rotation, car wash, courtesy inspection and courtesy vacuum. Mention the offer when you book. Some exclusions apply and it can't be combined with other offers. ($5 OFF Lube, oil & filter change)
- Tires: Need tires? Ask us for a tire quote.
- Car Wash: Our new Washworld Profile ST is a friction wash built for a wide range of vehicle types. Gets the dirt and bugs off.
- Propane Fill Station: Bring your tank by for a refill, buy a spare, or drop off an old tank for disposal. We fill tanks for grills, motor homes, forklifts and more.
- Fuel Pumps: Marathon gas in various grades, plus kerosene and diesel fuel.
- Convenience Store: Everyday items and snacks. Grab something while you wait on your car, or stock up before a road trip.

## FAQ
Q: Do you have free air for tires?
A: Yes. Two reviewers mention getting free air, and both say staff helped them fill their tires.

Q: Do you sell non-oxygenated gas?
A: Yes. Non-oxygenated gas is always available at our pumps.

Q: Can I get rid of an old propane tank?
A: Yes. Bring an old tank in for disposal, or pick up a spare while you're here.

Q: Will you remind me when my car is due?
A: Yes. After your service, we send friendly reminders that let you know when it's time to come back.
